Built for the region

Compliant in the GCC, by default

XionERP speaks the language of regional finance — Arabic e-invoicing, OMR to three decimals, multi-currency, and IFRS-standard reporting out of the box. No bolt-ons, no scramble before a deadline.

Oman's national e-invoicing mandate (Fawtara) rolls out in phases from 2026 to 2028. XionERP generates e-invoices in UBL 2.1 / Peppol BIS 3.0 format, aligned with the Oman Tax Authority's requirements ahead of the rollout.

Questions about XionERP

What is XionERP?

XionERP is a cloud ERP for growing GCC businesses. Accounting, sales, CRM, inventory, purchase, manufacturing, projects, assets, HR and payroll, field sales, point of sale and maintenance run on one platform and one set of data.

Does XionERP support e-invoicing in Oman?

Yes. XionERP generates e-invoices in UBL 2.1 and Peppol BIS 3.0 format, built for Oman's e-invoicing requirements ahead of the phased rollout.

Do all plans include every module?

Yes. Every XionERP plan includes the full platform. Plans differ only by the number of user seats.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. You get a 30-day free trial and no credit card is required to start.

Which currencies does XionERP support?

OMR to three decimal places, USD, LKR and other regional currencies, with conversion for multi-entity and cross-border businesses.

Can I send invoices and chat with customers on WhatsApp?

Yes. XionERP sends invoices, quotations, statements and reminders on WhatsApp from the document itself, and you answer customer chats from an inbox inside XionERP. It uses the official WhatsApp Business Platform, on your own number.

Can I connect XionERP to Claude?

Yes. You can add XionERP to your own Claude as a connector and ask about overdue receivables, sales or stock. Claude can also draft documents, and every write is previewed and confirmed before anything posts.
